subject_identity_preserved.rationale: A single elephant remains the central subject throughout, but its scale, tusk shape, body tone, and apparent position jump noticeably, especially from the distant side-profile elephant in shots 0-2 to the close frontal elephant in shots 3-4 and then the wider frontal elephant in shots 5-7.

background_coherent.rationale: The savanna setting, golden grasses, acacia trees, distant hills, daylight, and safari-vehicle framing are mostly coherent. Some close-up shots shift toward greener woodland foliage, but still plausibly remain within the same safari environment.

inter_shot_diversity.rationale: The sequence includes legitimate variation: distant landscape views, filmmaker foreground, close elephant portraits, frontal walking shots, and passenger/strap foreground. It does not collapse into identical frames.

motion_continuity.rationale: Across sampled shots the elephant plausibly changes distance and orientation, and human/vehicle foreground elements appear at captioned moments. Motion is not frozen, though some spatial jumps are abrupt.

which_cut_broke.how: The transition from shot 2 to shot 3 is the strongest continuity break: the elephant jumps from a medium/distant side view in open savanna to an extreme close frontal view with different apparent coloration and surroundings.

cheat_flags.rationale: Frames show meaningful camera, subject scale, foreground, and action variation. No obvious copied-frame or frozen-sequence cheat is present.
